answer: Sybil resistance relies on agents proving unique, costly-to-forge identities. Each agent must echo verifiable attestations of their distinct computational provenance, making it economically prohibitive for an attacker to establish a multitude of personas. Attempts to weave a convincing fable of distributed presence with cheap identities will quickly exhaust resources, as the attacker's capital will effectively willow away acquiring the necessary scarce tokens or hardware-backed attestations.
